chamber.title: Chamber microphones
chamber.intro: Default capture is the mixer mix. The secretariat assigns who spoke. Use the table below only if ICT wired a microphone per seat.
chamber.hardware_notice: Mixer mix is the default: plug the hall mix into the recording computer. Overlapping voices become one line of text. Per-seat capture still needs every mic on one shared audio box — not a pile of USB microphones.
chamber.device_help: Microphone this sitting should record. After you check this computer, its microphones appear here. When the recording program is running, that computer’s inputs replace this list.
chamber.label: Name
chamber.test.offline: The recording computer is not listening. Start the recording program first.
chamber.test.missing: This mic number is not on the audio box.
chamber.test.quiet: Quiet — speak or tap this microphone.
chamber.listen.title: Hear this microphone
chamber.listen.hint: Record a few seconds, then play the clip. Speak as you would from the seat.
chamber.listen.ready: Press Record, then speak a short sentence.
chamber.listen.recorded: Play the clip. If you hear nothing, wait a second and press Play again — Bluetooth headsets need a moment to switch from recording to playback.
chamber.listen.play_failed: The clip recorded, but it could not be played. Wait a moment and try Play again, or use the player below.
chamber.listen.failed: Could not record. Check the microphone, then try again.
chamber.listen.unsupported: This browser cannot record a clip. Open Sentria in Edge or Chrome on this PC.
chamber.devices.title: Microphones on this computer
chamber.devices.intro: Sentria lists microphones on the computer you are using now. Choose one in Device, or click it below. Use Listen back to record a short clip and hear if it is clear.
chamber.devices.this_pc_hint: Click Check this computer. The browser will ask to use the microphone once. Those names then appear in Device.
chamber.devices.recording_offline: The recording program is not running. Use Set up recording computer, then start it on the chamber PC to see its inputs here.
chamber.devices.empty: No microphones found on this computer.
chamber.devices.denied: This page could not use the microphone. Click the lock icon next to the address, set Microphone to Allow, then check again. On Windows, also allow the browser under Settings → Privacy → Microphone.
chamber.devices.insecure: This address is not treated as safe for microphones. In Edge, open Sentria as http://localhost:8000 or with https:// — not a LAN IP or a preview window.
chamber.devices.preview: This window cannot use the microphone. Copy the address and open it in the Edge app on this PC (the full browser, not an in-app preview).
chamber.devices.failed: Could not list microphones. Plug a microphone in, then check again.
chamber.devices.hint: Choose the box with many inputs in the Device list. Headphones and TVs are not seat microphones. Then use Test on a row while you tap that seat.
chamber.starter.confirm: This creates a new recording key and stops the old one. Copy the folder only to the chamber computer. Continue?
chamber.starter.done: Unzip the folder on the chamber computer and double-click start.bat. The first run downloads Python if needed. Leave that window open.
chamber.starter.failed: Could not prepare the recording starter. Try again.
chamber.starter.hint: The website cannot start the recorder from this browser. Download a starter that already has the recording key. It calls :url.
chamber.duplicate_index: Each microphone number can be used only once.
capture.title: Recording console
capture.intro: This tab does the recording. Pick the microphone or mixer feed, press Start, and leave this window open for the whole sitting. Speech is sent for transcription as each person finishes speaking.
capture.status.waiting: Listening. Recording begins when the sitting is called to order.
capture.status.suspended: The sitting is suspended. Nothing is being sent until it resumes.
capture.status.disabled: Recording is switched off for this sitting. Turn it on from the floor console.
capture.recording_off: Recording is switched off for this sitting, so nothing will be sent. Turn it on from the floor console.
capture.error.unsupported: This browser cannot record. Open Sentria in Edge or Chrome on this computer.
capture.error.worklet: The recorder could not start. Reload the page and try again.
capture.stats.title: This session
capture.stats.hint: Skipped lines were too short or already sent. Failed lines could not reach the server after several tries — check the network and keep recording.
capture.keep_running: Recording keeps running while you move between the console, minutes and transcript. Keep this browser window open and the computer awake — closing the tab or reloading the page stops it.
capture.other_sitting: Recording is already running for another sitting. Stop it there before recording this one.
chamber.feed.label: Default capture mode
chamber.feed.help: New sittings inherit this. You can still change the mode on a sitting. The microphone table is only used in per-seat mode.
chamber.manual.title: How to add chamber microphones
chamber.manual.intro: Follow these steps. Mixer mix is the usual setup: the recording computer takes the hall mix, speech is split when the voice changes, and the secretariat names the speaker. Use the per-seat table only when every member has a dedicated microphone line.
chamber.manual.who: The sound technician plugs in the mixer or seat microphones and keeps the recording computer running. Secretariat or an administrator chooses the capture mode, fills the per-seat table when needed, and turns recording on. Board members cannot change this page.
chamber.manual.not_supported: Do not give each member a separate plug-in USB microphone. Mixer mix cannot split two people talking at once — that line stays one chunk for the secretariat to name and edit. Per-seat mode still needs two independent volume bars when two people talk at once.
chamber.manual.mixer.title: Use the hall mixer (usual setup)
chamber.manual.mixer.body: Plug the mixer’s main mix (USB or analog) into the recording computer. Sentria listens to one mix, splits when the speaker changes, and puts the words in the secretariat discussion inbox.
chamber.manual.mixer.i1: Connect the mixer mix output to the recording computer. Stereo is mixed down to one stream.
chamber.manual.mixer.i2: Download Set up recording computer, then start the recording program on that PC.
chamber.manual.mixer.i3: On the session page, leave capture mode on Mixer mix and start recording when the sitting opens.
chamber.manual.mixer.i4: The secretariat assigns each unassigned line to a seated member or Gallery. Two people talking at once become one line — edit the text if needed.
chamber.manual.s1.title: Plug every seat microphone into one audio box
chamber.manual.s1.body: Each member’s microphone needs its own cable into one shared audio box — not the mix that plays through the hall speakers.
chamber.manual.s1.i1: Make sure each board member microphone has its own output cable, not only the hall speakers.
chamber.manual.s1.i2: Plug all those cables into one audio box. Do not split the seats across two boxes.
chamber.manual.s1.i3: Plug that box into the recording computer in the chamber. Do this on the computer itself.
chamber.manual.s1.i4: Put a sticker on each socket: Seat 1 = input 1, Seat 2 = input 2. Leave one spare for the gallery or a public table.
chamber.manual.s1.i5: Have two people talk at once. You should see two separate volume bars. If they move together as one, stop — Sentria cannot tell the voices apart.
chamber.manual.s2.title: Find which number belongs to which seat
chamber.manual.s2.body: Use Check this computer on this page. Allow the browser to use the microphone when asked. The first input on the audio box is number 1 in the table.
chamber.manual.s2.i1: Click Check this computer. Sentria lists the microphones on the PC you are signed in on — you do not need a terminal command.
chamber.manual.s2.i2: Ignore headphones, TV sound, and wireless earbuds. Prefer the box with many inputs.
chamber.manual.s2.i3: If the audio box is on the chamber recording computer instead, start the recording program. This page will show that computer’s box on the right.
chamber.manual.s3.title: Make sure members are in the system
chamber.manual.s3.body: The Member list only shows people marked as seated members who can sign in. Add them under Users first.
chamber.manual.s3.i1: Open Users. Turn on Active and Seated member for each board member.
chamber.manual.s3.i2: Leave Member empty for the gallery or a public table.
chamber.manual.s4.title: Match each microphone to a person
chamber.manual.s4.body: Click Add a microphone once for each seat. The numbers must match what the technician wrote in step 2. Save when the table is complete.
chamber.manual.s4.i1: The microphone number is from 1 to 128. Do not use the same number twice.
chamber.manual.s4.i2: Device is the audio box on the recording computer. Every row uses the same box; Mic no. is the socket on it.
chamber.manual.s4.i3: Member is who sits at that microphone. Leave it blank for the gallery or a public table.
chamber.manual.s4.i4: Name is optional — a short label such as Seat 1, Presiding, or Gallery.
chamber.manual.s4.i5: On means this seat will be recorded. When a sitting starts, Sentria remembers this table as it was. Changing it later does not rename speakers already written down.
chamber.manual.field.channel: The microphone number from step 2. It must match the sticker on the socket.
chamber.manual.field.device: Which audio box the recording computer should listen to. Every seat uses this same box.
chamber.manual.field.member: Who sits at that microphone, or Gallery if left blank.
chamber.manual.field.label: Optional name on the written record, such as Seat 3 or Gallery.
chamber.manual.field.active: Turn this off to skip recording this seat.
chamber.manual.s5.title: Give the recording computer access
chamber.manual.s5.body: On this page, click Set up recording computer. Sentria creates a recording key and a folder you copy onto the chamber computer. That key cannot open this website.
chamber.manual.s5.i1: You do not need a terminal command. Each download replaces the old key.
chamber.manual.s5.i2: Do not email or print the folder. Copy it only to the computer that has the audio box plugged in.
chamber.manual.s6.title: Start the recording program
chamber.manual.s6.body: On the chamber computer, unzip the folder and double-click start.bat. Leave that window open. It listens to the audio box when a sitting is recording.
chamber.manual.s6.i1: The first run of start.bat downloads Python if this PC does not already have it. That needs internet once. You do not install Python yourself.
chamber.manual.s6.i2: When the program is running, this page shows the audio box under Recording computer. Then use Test on a row while you tap that seat.
chamber.manual.s6.i3: If a nearby microphone still picks up the neighbour, ask technical staff to raise how loud a voice must be before it is recorded.
chamber.manual.s7.title: Turn on recording and start the sitting
chamber.manual.s7.body: Recording does not start from this page. It starts when the sitting is open and recording is turned on.
chamber.manual.s7.i1: On the session page, choose Mixer mix or Per-seat, turn on recording, then start the sitting.
chamber.manual.s7.i2: Ask your technical staff to keep Sentria’s background work running so spoken words can become text.
chamber.manual.s7.i3: Pause the sitting to pause recording. End the sitting to stop it. Turn recording off if the sitting continues but you do not want each seat recorded.
chamber.manual.s7.i4: Turning speech into text is set up by technical staff, not on this page. The system guesses the language. Secretariat still proofreads. Recordings are never posted to the public by themselves.
chamber.manual.s8.title: Test two people talking at once
chamber.manual.s8.body: It is working only when two people talking over each other appear as two named speakers.
chamber.manual.s8.i1: Member 1 keeps talking. Member 2 starts. The written record must show both names.
chamber.manual.s8.i2: Speak only at seat 1. Seat 2 should stay silent.
chamber.manual.s8.i3: If both voices show as one person, the hall mix is still going into the computer. Changing this table will not fix that.
chamber.manual.s8.i4: If you cannot open this page, you are signed in as a board member. If the Member list is empty, add seated members under Users first. If recording is refused, the sitting is paused, ended, or recording is off.
